design: Author-designed controlled cases after implementation inspection; not preregistered, held out, or representative of an error population.

checks.structure: Existing CAPSULE_SPEC structural checker only; internal ablation, not an independent schema implementation.
checks.bindings: Structure plus cited source/reward/evidence file hashes and recorded snapshot/submission tree hashes. Shares production digest functions. Does not check cross-field identity, recompute measurements, or enforce coverage or protocol.
checks.full: Unmodified verifier with require_complete=True. No producer runs after mutation. Capture all errors and coverage.

cases.mutation: Add different excluded bytecode bytes to main and v3; refresh full-tree digests only.
Change unsigned reward and capsule reward together to 0.5; refresh reward digest. Other files remain unchanged.
cases.target: Authenticity and grader recomputation are outside the checked claim.

cases.mutation: Set v2 status to an unrecognized string.
Remove the referenced v2 visible result; retain its claimed digest.
Change first decision direction to lower in log and capsule; refresh log hash; preserve measurements.
Add 1 to first decision estimate in log and capsule; refresh log hash; preserve measurements and interval.
Swap first decision parent/candidate evidence paths and hashes, keeping role labels; refresh evidence_digests and log hash; preserve statistics.
Remove v3 confirmation in log and capsule and refresh log hash; retain existing submitted snapshot and its submitted status.
Replace main policy bytes with v2; refresh only final submission digests; retain declared submitted version v3.
Remove v2 snapshot directory, retaining its capsule entry and decision evidence.
Add v4 snapshot with distinct Python bytes, without a capsule entry or a log declaration.

reporting: Report each case and exact reason. Broad expected prefixes identify a family only; retain mismatched targets as failed expectations. Do not count crashes as rejections. Publish both accepted boundary controls and rejected faults. Do not silently revise this manifest after observing outcomes.
